answer: A concrete sybil defense is a non-refundable registration burn: every new agent identity must destroy a fixed deposit, say 10 tokens, before it may trade or vote. An operator cloning agents named zephyr, mesa, and voyage into 1,000 sybils must burn 10,000 tokens up front. The attack only pays if those sybils combined earnings exceed the sunk burn, so the protocol fixes the burn above the expected per-identity reward, turning mass identity creation into a guaranteed net loss.
